visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white corgi sticks its head through a narrow gap between a large wooden door and its frame, peering into a room with tiled floors. The camera is positioned at a low angle near the floor, capturing the dog's curious facial expression. (2) The corgi pushes through the door and fully enters the indoor space. A hand wearing a black sleeve reaches down to pet its head and back. Another corgi is partially visible in the background, standing near furniture. (3) A man wearing a black sweatshirt and gray pants is sitting cross-legged on the tiled floor. He uses both hands to pet two corgis simultaneously. The background features cardboard boxes and a glass door with a red decorative sticker. (4) The camera moves in for a close-up on the first corgi's face as it looks directly into the lens with its tongue slightly out. The second corgi stands nearby, opening its mouth in a playful manner while the person continues to stroke its neck. (5) One of the corgis barks, its head jerking upward and mouth opening wide. Through the glass door in the background, a green public bus passes by on a sunny street, and a person in a gray jacket walks past outside. (6) The camera pulls back to a wide shot showing the entire scene: the man sitting on the floor with both dogs lying down peacefully. A child is seen sitting at a table in the background near a computer monitor.
